extensions.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); outcomes are resolved from durable artifacts (ledger entries, merged PRs, test results), never from a later summary written by the same agent that made the claim
tests_required_verbatim: detector control: include 5 claims whose outcome is genuinely still unknown and require the pipeline to exclude them rather than score them; scoring an unresolved claim silently biases the calibration
extensions.completion_marker_protocol: Literal JSON-permitted U+0085 delimiters preserve one parseable JSON document while Unicode splitlines exposes the exact completion line at tail.
